# Brief 04: Post merger integration

Audience: Helix Packaging integration steering committee.
Decision: confirm the 100-day plan, the $48M synergy target and recovery actions for five red workstreams.
Format: 9 slides, density balanced. Start with a cover and end with next steps.
Data: data.csv holds workstream status by function used on slide 4.

## Facts

F1: The combined business has revenue of $860M: Helix 610 and Corran 250 (USD million).
F2: The synergy target is $48M run-rate in three years: $36M of cost and $12M of revenue synergies.
F3: Cost synergies by source (USD million): procurement 15, footprint 12, SG&A 9; revenue synergies 12.
F4: Synergy phasing (USD million run-rate): year 1 14, year 2 33, year 3 48.
F5: One-time integration cost is $52M.
F6: At day 45, 26 of 40 workstreams are green, 9 amber and 5 red.
F7: Status by function (green, amber, red): Finance 6, 2, 0; Commercial 4, 2, 1; Operations 7, 2, 1; IT 4, 2, 2; HR 5, 1, 1.
F8: Annualised attrition at Corran is 8.4% against 5.1% at Helix; 14 of 60 key people are flagged as at risk.
F9: 22% of customers buy from both companies; three accounts worth $31M of revenue show signs of risk.
F10: Three ERP systems run today; the plan is to move to one by month 18.
F11: The 100-day plan has four gates: day 30 governance live, day 60 retention packages signed, day 90 customer plan agreed, day 100 ERP design frozen.
